rule: A case marked BLOCKED_BY_CONTRACT may run in behavior simulation but must not be counted as production-contract evidence until every listed gap is closed.

GAP_AD_ORIGIN.name: Ad/referral origin marker
GAP_AD_ORIGIN.detail: Inbound message has ads context, but sanitized Context V2 candidate input has no dedicated ad-origin / first-meaningful-inbound field.

GAP_PRODUCT_ATTRIBUTES.name: Customer-facing product attributes
GAP_PRODUCT_ATTRIBUTES.detail: Material, design, form, color labels, size list and display name are not registered protected claim families in the current candidate egress.
GAP_PRODUCT_ATTRIBUTES.production_owner: Product facts -> Context V2 claim registry

GAP_VARIANT_LABELS.name: Human-readable variant labels
GAP_VARIANT_LABELS.detail: STOCK scope can carry variantId, but color/size presentation metadata is not exposed as authoritative candidate data.

GAP_INSPECTION_POLICY.name: Inspection policy
GAP_INSPECTION_POLICY.detail: Policy can exist in system sources but is not a current candidate verified-claim type.

GAP_EXCHANGE_POLICY.name: Return/exchange/refund policy
GAP_EXCHANGE_POLICY.detail: Return, exchange and refund rules are not in current candidate egress.

GAP_PAYMENT_POLICY.name: Payment-method policy
GAP_PAYMENT_POLICY.detail: Payment extraction exists upstream, but supported payment methods/policy are not a current candidate factual claim family.

GAP_STORE_INFO.name: Store address/hours/try-on
GAP_STORE_INFO.detail: Store business data is not in current candidate egress.

GAP_CUSTOMIZATION.name: Customization/tailoring policy
GAP_CUSTOMIZATION.detail: No current verified claim represents customization availability.

GAP_RETAIL_COMBO.name: Retail component and combo semantics
GAP_RETAIL_COMBO.detail: PRICE alone cannot safely explain which component/configuration an amount belongs to.

GAP_CHANNEL_PRICE.name: Channel-specific price semantics
GAP_CHANNEL_PRICE.detail: PRICE value crossing egress has amount/currency but no channel applicability.

GAP_PROMO_SEMANTICS.name: Promotion eligibility semantics
GAP_PROMO_SEMANTICS.detail: PROMOTION_OFFER exposes adjustmentId/amountVnd, but not all gift/eligibility wording needed for customer explanation.

GAP_FULFILLMENT_STAGE.name: Production/dispatch fulfillment stage
GAP_FULFILLMENT_STAGE.detail: Product facts can carry fulfillment policy, while candidate ETA does not distinguish production lead time from delivery time.

GAP_ORDER_TOTAL.name: Trusted order/cart total
GAP_ORDER_TOTAL.detail: Current protected-claim set has no ORDER_TOTAL claim.

GAP_PRODUCT_LIFECYCLE.name: Discontinued lifecycle state
GAP_PRODUCT_LIFECYCLE.detail: STOCK statuses do not encode discontinued semantics.

GAP_CHECKOUT_COMPLETENESS.name: Checkout completeness / known delivery details
GAP_CHECKOUT_COMPLETENESS.detail: Current sanitized candidate canonical state can request checkout details but cannot represent that all required delivery fields are already known.
